title: Birth date and birthplace in the Creole Treme section
summary: Rene was born 1 March 1897 in New Orleans in the Creole section and says his brother was the youngest like him.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Well we were going to ask, what is your birthday?
First day of March, 1897. March the first, 1897. Were you born right here in New Orleans?
What section? The Creole section. What we call the Trimmy.
What about your brother, was he old or young?

No, he was the youngest one. He was young like me. I've got plenty to tell you now, I'll tell you. Well. I'll tell you now, you might want to know a history about Beyshe, or who you want to know about. Let me tell you, just tell me.
